definitions.explanation: A metal or other durable plate attached to machinery, equipment, or buildings that displays identifying information such as the manufacturer, model number, serial number, or specifications.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銘板|めいばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the nameplate on the machine.

examples.japanese: {銘板|めいばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{製造年月日|せいぞうねんがっぴ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The date of manufacture is listed on the nameplate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{真鍮|しんちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銘板|めいばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けられていた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: A brass nameplate was mounted at the entrance of the old building.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in manufacturing, engineering, and building contexts. The {銘板|めいばん} provides essential identification and specification data for equipment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銘板|めいばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check the nameplate)
- {銘板|めいばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧ (listed on the nameplate)
- {銘板|めいばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧ (to attach a nameplate)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{表札|ひょうさつ}→表札：04886_hyousatsu⟧: house nameplate (at a residence)
- ⟦{名札|なふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧: name tag (worn by a person)
